findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Sua necessidade. O fornecedor certo para convers" → 3 lines (7 words, 50.4px); "O que sua empresa faz pode ser o que outra preci" → 3 lines (12 words, 50.4px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 11 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Conexões que movem a indústria" above "O próximo acordo começa aqui."; "Seu negócio tem dois lados. Nós conectamos." above "Quem precisa encontra. Quem faz, acontec"; "O acordo merece mais que mensagens soltas" above "Veja o contexto. Decida com clareza."; "Do primeiro requisito ao último registro" above "Uma compra. Cada etapa conectada."; "Etapa 01 / 07" above "Tudo começa com uma necessidade."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "04", "05", "06"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 17 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Conexões que movem a indústria", "INDÚSTRIA REAL.RELAÇÕES QUE FAZEM ACONTE", "Seu negócio tem dois lados. Nós conectam", "O acordo merece mais que mensagens solta").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 1 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.sv-record-sheet → rgba(37, 53, 26, 0.04) 0px 7px 15px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 22 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.sv-header 1440px | div.sv-value-strip.sv-shell 1280px | div.sv-workflow-layout 1280px | ol 240px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 4 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 2 rows of identical boxed cards.
findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: Cream + terracotta palette (section #f7f7f2, button #e85d2d).
findings.fix: Re-draw the palette from the library. This pairing reads as an assistant brand, not yours.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "acontece." 2.2:1 (#a5aca2 on #f7f7f2)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.3:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 142 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 84 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 709px of the width empty: "Sua capacidade.".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.sv-hero-shade → linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(16, 32, 23, 0.91), rgba(16, 32, 23, 0.4)), linear-gradient(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 20%, r
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: A 468px stretch at 10320px holds nothing.
findings.fix: Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: A data-ui element wraps a heading or more than a screen and a half of the page.
findings.fix: data-ui marks a cropped interface fragment only. Remove it from page-level wrappers.

findings.message: 9 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 136px at 1312px; 404px at 3192px; 500px at 4756px; 1108px at 5640px (the screen is 225px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.
